# Governance

NEXUS Platform AB has final authority over the project's roadmap, architecture, releases and merge decisions. The project has no voting body or elected technical committee.

Maintainers are NEXUS Platform AB staff who have write access to the repository. NEXUS Platform AB resolves any disagreements between maintainers.

External contributions do not grant voting rights, commit access, employment or decision-making authority. Maintainers may seek advice from external contributors and may choose to act on it.

## Licence and contributor rights

Source code owned by NEXUS Platform AB in this repository is distributed under the [GNU Affero General Public License, version 3.0 or later](https://github.com/nexusapp/nexus/blob/main/LICENSE). The licence permits its use, modification and redistribution subject to its terms.

NEXUS Platform AB does not require contributors to sign a contributor licence agreement or assign their copyright. Contributors retain the copyright in their work.

Every commit made by a contributor must include the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org) sign-off required by the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/nexusapp/nexus/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md). Pull requests opened by NEXUS repository automation are exempt from this requirement.

## Name and marks

NEXUS and the NEXUS logo are trademarks of NEXUS Platform AB. Neither the AGPL nor the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence on NEXUS artwork grants trademark rights. NEXUS Platform AB grants everyone the following permissions.

- You may distribute unmodified builds of NEXUS, or builds with light patches, under the NEXUS name and logo. Light patches are changes for packaging, portability, security and bug fixes, configuration defaults and translations. Linux distributions, nixpkgs, Flathub and container images are all covered.
- A self-hosted instance running such a build may show the NEXUS name and logo under the instance's own name and domain, as long as it does not imply affiliation with or endorsement by NEXUS Platform AB.
- You may refer to NEXUS by name to describe compatibility, for example "works with NEXUS".

Forks with substantive functional changes must use their own name and logo. Any other use needs permission from NEXUS Platform AB. Contact support@nexus.com.
